messages.body_plain:
Sure, just head over to http://cran.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu/ and follow the instructions. After that, upgrade your packages in Ubuntu, add yourself to "staff" once again (just to make sure). You may need to log out afterwards, it's been a while since I used Ubuntu... anyway, start R interactive session in terminal and issue the command:

> update.packages(ask = FALSE, checkBuilt = TRUE)

This will update packages installed by previous R version. Note that most of these are probably have to get recompiled, so make sure that you have r-base-dev package installed. It will require more CPU time, but (in theory) they should run faster once they're compiled. And note that the "sluggish" part stands only for packages with C code. R stuff gets done in a jiffy.
